en.headline: Lo says Kwong Wah A&E can cover area as QEH moves to Kai Tak
en.dek: The health chief said Queen Elizabeth Hospital services will shift in stages to Kai Tak Hospital, with Kwong Wah's rebuilt emergency department now three times larger.
body: Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau said services at Queen Elizabeth Hospital will move in stages to Kai Tak Hospital, and that the rebuilt accident and emergency department at Kwong Wah Hospital can meet demand in the surrounding area.

Speaking on Friday, Professor Lo said the two existing emergency departments had sat close together and that splitting patients between them had not always worked well. The opening of Kai Tak Hospital, he said, offered a chance to rearrange acute hospital services across Kowloon.

After the Kwong Wah rebuild, the accident and emergency department is three times larger than before and 40 extra emergency beds have been added, he said. Kai Tak Hospital has already begun rolling out outpatient and community services, with inpatient, operating theatre and emergency department services previously scheduled for a later phase.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：伊院服務遷啟德 廣華急症室可應付當區
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長表示伊利沙伯醫院服務將分階段遷往啟德醫院，重建後的廣華急症室面積擴大三倍，足以應付附近需求。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，伊利沙伯醫院服務將分階段遷往啟德醫院，而廣華醫院重建後的急症室已可應付附近地區的急症需求。
盧寵茂周五表示，以往伊院與廣華急症室距離接近，分流哪些病人應到哪一間醫院的效果並不理想。隨著啟德醫院投入服務，當局認為是重新布局整個九龍區急症醫院服務的契機。
他指出，廣華醫院重建後急症室面積較以往大三倍，並增加40張急症病床。啟德醫院已分階段開展門診及基層醫療等服務，住院、手術及急症室服務則按較後階段開展。
